workshop_report.initial.title: WS-04 · Procure-to-Pay follow-up
workshop_report.initial.summary: A faithful record of a new threshold statement and the unresolved company-code scope.

sections.title: Reported threshold
sections.content: WS-04 states that purchase orders above EUR 50,000 require procurement director approval.

sections.title: Open question
sections.content: The workshop did not establish the applicable company code or whether this replaces the earlier decision.

sections.title: Candidate decision
sections.content: Proposed for stewardship review: replace EUR 25,000 with EUR 50,000 only after the scope is clarified and an authorized domain lead approves.

fit_gap.initial.title: P2P approval · Proposed fit-gap
fit_gap.initial.summary: A review item, not a resolved fit-gap publication.

sections.title: Fit assessment
sections.content: Configuration impact cannot be determined: the current approved FR01 threshold is EUR 25,000; WS-04 reports EUR 50,000 with unclear scope. Both remain visible and no supersession is asserted.

sections.title: Reference requirement
sections.content: The source identifies standard purchase-order approval management as the initial process scope; configuration and authorization remain subject to design review.

sections.title: Required clarification
sections.content: Determine the company-code scope before assessing configuration impact or publishing the proposed delta.

steering_deck.initial.title: Steering committee · Decision exposure
steering_deck.initial.summary: One decision requires clarification before configuration can be treated as settled.

sections.title: Approved baseline
sections.content: The validated company-code FR01 rule remains EUR 25,000 until a scoped replacement is approved.

sections.title: Scope and control
sections.content: WS-04 reports EUR 50,000, but does not establish its company-code scope or supersede the baseline.

sections.title: Requested owner action
sections.content: Provide written company-code clarification; the steering summary does not select either threshold as the settled enterprise rule.

fit_gap.resolved.title: P2P approval · Clarified fit-gap
fit_gap.resolved.summary: Approved scope and superseded history support a new configuration review.

sections.title: Validated decision
sections.content: For FR01, the approved threshold is EUR 50,000 above which procurement director approval applies, effective 2026-11-05.

sections.title: Fit assessment
sections.content: Configuration review is required against the synthetic role-based configurable approval reference; no product-specific gap is asserted.

sections.title: Control boundary
sections.content: The decision replaces the earlier amount only for company code FR01. No urgent-purchase-order exception applies. Historical v1 remains available.

steering_deck.resolved.title: Steering committee · Decision closed
steering_deck.resolved.summary: The scoped threshold decision is approved and linked to immutable history.

sections.title: Decision closed
sections.content: For FR01, the approved threshold changed from EUR 25,000 to EUR 50,000, effective 2026-11-05.

sections.title: Scope and control
sections.content: The supersession applies only to FR01; procurement director approval applies above EUR 50,000 with no urgent-purchase-order exception.

workshop_report.accepted_clarification.title: WS-04 · Conflict review accepted
workshop_report.accepted_clarification.summary: WS-05 supplies scoped clarification; knowledge promotion remains a separate gate.

sections.title: Reported threshold
sections.content: EUR 50,000 replaces EUR 25,000 only for FR01 in the accepted WS-05 clarification; canonical v1 has not yet changed.

sections.title: Open question
sections.content: The initial scope question is answered in new evidence, but the domain lead has not yet promoted the accepted candidate.

sections.title: Candidate decision
sections.content: Proceed to the independent promote-to-knowledge action, then generate the resolved deliverables.

workshop_report.resolved.title: WS-05 · Approved process-owner clarification
workshop_report.resolved.summary: Written scope confirmation, with previous decision history retained.

sections.title: Confirmed scope
sections.content: FR01 is now explicitly covered by the EUR 50,000 threshold, effective 2026-11-05.

sections.title: Supersession
sections.content: The earlier EUR 25,000 decision is replaced only for FR01 and remains available in approval history.
